verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm that provides legal services through lawyers and consultations, not a software product a user operates. Operating it via natural-language commands is therefore a category error rather than a missing feature. The evidence shows no software interface: no llms.txt, no OpenAPI spec, and only consultation booking and newsletter signups.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
